about.title: About us
about.paragraph1: ElderAid started from a simple observation: many older people need small everyday help - a trip to the shop, someone to walk with, company in the afternoon - but finding the right person is hard.
about.paragraph2: We're building a service where every helper verifies their identity, and where family members can follow along from a distance.
